digest.component_or_area: review_kernel and consumer pipeline integration (plan_review / code_review)
propositions: verify_findings() outcome_counts tally (clean/recovered/empty_outcomes/unrecoverable) is shared kernel logic but not consistently wired into both plan_review and code_review consumer pipeline telemetry

code_review_decide() lacks contract_violation sink entirely and only logs errors, while plan_review_decide() uses a ContextVar-backed collect_contract_violations/record_contract_violation/drain_contract_violations sink that must be moved to review_kernel and reused

outcome_counts cannot track per-chunk empty_outcomes/unrecoverable at the *_decide merged boundary without verify prompt step emitting per-chunk metadata as named workflow output (deferred follow-on), so whole-run tally helper must derive clean/recovered/empty_outcomes/unrecoverable from raw_verifs, findings, and VerificationReshape only
contract_violations and outcome_counts must be added as additive coverage keys to both plan_review_decide and code_review_decide outputs with no change to decision thresholds or verdict shape
